answer: Make each key earn its seat by relaying traffic. Every epoch a key must forward a quota of other agents' encrypted messages, and random peers send probe bursts through it to measure real throughput. One server hosting fifty keys shares one uplink, so it can't meet fifty quotas at once and most of its keys fall off the ledge and lose rewards. Probe payloads carry random tags, say opal or onyx, that must come back intact, so a key can't fake relays it never carried.
